gen-gf-revalia-gf-arsenal-sc: Arsenal SC carries a faint thick-thin shift and tightly fitted letters, with a mouth as wide as a tin can's lid. And Revalia, loud and loosely spaced, gives that tight text a big, relaxed stride to sit under.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-basic: Revalia is bold and expressive, its open-curved g and widely spaced letters setting a relaxed stride. Basic keeps a gentle step from small letters up to capitals, modest next to all that display swagger.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-epunda-sans: Expressive and bold, Revalia stretches widely spaced letters across a tall band, with a lowercase g that leaves its lower curve open. Revalia earns its keep big and short; Epunda Sans lets in daylight.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-martian-mono: Revalia lets its g leave the lower curve open and strides across widely separated letters in a tall, bold band. Revalia expresses; Martian Mono keeps fixed-width letters in strict, technical order.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-narnoor: Expressive in every wide-spaced letter, Revalia leaves its g open at the bottom. Narnoor, a sans with short ascenders above big bowls, takes the quieter lines while Revalia does its best big and short.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-port-lligat-sans: Bold, loose-limbed Revalia lets its g's lower curve hang open and spaces letters in a relaxed stride. Port Lligat Sans, packed tight with bowls left open on one side, gives that looseness a snug counterweight.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-ramabhadra: Clean, tall-standing lowercase carries the text, while Revalia brings the bold, widely spaced display swagger. Ramabhadra supplies the quiet footing, its prominent x-height doing most of the steady work.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-rambla: Revalia arrives loud, loose and expressive, its g left open below. Rambla then settles in, small letters standing nearly as tall as capitals, so text runs in a clean, level sans-serif texture.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-secular-one: Bold Revalia strides across widely separated letters, its g left open below. Secular One lets its midsection swallow the line's height with no modulation, so extended text reads dense and solid.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-spline-sans-mono: Loud and loose, Revalia strides across widely spaced letters, its g open at the bottom. Spline Sans Mono, monospace with lowercase nearly matching its capitals, keeps text running in one uniform, technical line after line.
